craft_notes: Sthāyin: praise of the needless helper. Device: dropped line-1 comma (serving runs on), added pause before darling (desired held), kept landing dash (hail struck). Rejected: 'lone' for 'singly' — killed: eka means one/alone; singly keeps the count. Read aloud: lands on close.

lines: To the Unserved who serves the threefold singly
to all men's darling, who desires nought, to Tangle-locks — hail.
l4.sanskrit_cite: namo nirupakāryāya trailokyaikopakāriṇe sarvasya spṛhaṇīyāya niḥspṛhāya kapardine

reads_against.argmap: Bow to needing-no-service, sole helper of three worlds.; Of all desired, to desireless, to matted-haired. → Bow to desireless helper of all, desired by all.
c1_essence: Needing nothing, helping all three worlds; desired of all, desiring nothing.
reads_against.c1_rasa: bhakti with audārya (generosity tasted and returned)
reads_against.l2: I bow to the unserved servitor of all three worlds; to him whom all crave, who craves nothing, the matted hair.
l3: To the Unserved who serves the threefold singly,
to all men's darling who desires nought, to Tangle-locks — hail.
